related.description: Quickly go back to a parent directory in linux instead of typing "cd ../../.." repeatedly
A ZSH plugin to allow easy named directory creation - shortcuts to any directory you want
Jump quickly to directories that you have visited "frecently." A native Zsh port of z.sh with added features.
Simplify zsh directory navigation; jump to already visited, parent or sub folders.
ZSH plugin that re-enters working directory if it has been removed and re-created.
